reverse_orphan_checks: Every authoritative LLD-05 command has exactly one bounded traceability edge proving request/response, transaction boundary, revision effects, audit, stable errors, tests and COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 or the exact shared outer-command equivalent.
Every LLD-05 query has deterministic total ordering, bounded point semantics or CURSOR_V1 keyset pagination, supporting index evidence and concrete acceptance tests.

Source WFM plan, current accepted operational Task plan, Objective membership-pinned plan/envelope and actual execution are four distinct authorities; no import, timezone presentation, regroup preview or Objective review silently rewrites another layer.
Automatic grouping computes transitive global strict-overlap components with exact-touch separation in O(n log n); Customer/RFC context explains work but never partitions temporal overlap authority.

Regroup proposals are non-authoritative exact diffs until separately accepted; acceptance reruns current plan/membership/lock/Objectives/nonoverlap guards in one UnitOfWork and preserves superseded Objective identity/history.
Provider Complete/Plan Cancel and RFC terminal evidence never fabricate local Task execution/outcome; historical Objective acceptance creates structure only from exact reviewed source-plan evidence.

RfcTerminalTaskParticipant owns one complete Task/Objective cascade-impact algorithm for both read-only preview fingerprinting and same-UoW writer revalidation; a reviewed exact_count/provider_fingerprint mismatch or INDETERMINATE state blocks LLD-03 Execute before participant apply, and READY apply creates no nested receipt/commit.
Objective scheduling timezone affects schedule interpretation/calendar/MW presentation only and never changes canonical UTC instants or LLD-06 SLA chronology.

Hard deletion remains a narrow correction path for provably untouched local history; source-adopted, execution-bearing, reviewed, retry-linked, archived, superseded or cross-domain-dependent Task/Objectives fail closed and identities are never reused.
